Travelers Cos Common (TRV) Holder Fort Washington Investment Advisors Has Increased Stake; Contrarius Investment Management LTD Has Increased Position in Tripadvisor (TRIP) by $5.73 Million as Stock Price Rose
May 9, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Fort Washington Investment Advisors Inc increased its stake in Travelers Cos Inc Common (TRV) by 4368.31% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fort Washington Investment Advisors Inc bought 188,274 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.76% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 192,584 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $26.12M, up from 4,310 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fort Washington Investment Advisors Inc who had been investing in Travelers Cos Inc Common for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $34.87 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.28% or $0.36 during the last trading session, reaching $129.02. About 310,862 shares traded. The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:TRV) has risen 13.01% since May 9, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.46% the S&P500.

The institutional investor held 1.35 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $46.50 million, up from 1.18M at the end of the previous reported quarter.
